blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre livros de oratória a partir de uma resenha crítica, usando linguagem avaliativa com entonação adequada.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: “The Podium and the People”
paras: In this **brisk, absorbing** study, the (fictional) historian Miriam Hale traces how **civic oratory** shaped three centuries of public life. Her gift is **to let the speeches speak**: long extracts are **woven** into an argument that never **loses its thread**.

The book is **not without flaws**. Hale **dwells** on well-known orators and **gives short shrift** to the grassroots speakers who **rarely made the record**. Her closing chapter, **moreover**, **leans heavily** on one theory of persuasion, and **sits uneasily** beside the evidence she has gathered.
**Still**, these are **quibbles** about a book of rare **clarity**. **Anyone who has ever wondered** why some sentences change minds **will find** answers here. **Highly recommended.**

items.q: The reviewer finds the book boring.
Hale gives little attention to grassroots speakers.

items.why: quibbles about a book of rare clarity.

blocks.body: Resenhas equilibram **elogio**, **ressalva** e **veredito**. Litotes (*not without flaws*) suavizam a crítica.

items.s: The author gives short ___ to grassroots speakers. (shrift)
___, these are quibbles about a book of rare clarity. (still)
Anyone who has wondered ___ find answers here. (will)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: She gives short shrift to grassroots speakers
items.pt: Ela dá pouca atenção aos oradores de base.

body: **Give short shrift to** — dar pouca atenção a
**A tour de force** — uma obra magistral
**Fall short of** — ficar aquém de
**Not without its flaws** — não sem falhas
**A page-turner** — livro que prende
**Stand the test of time** — resistir ao tempo
**Strike the right balance** — encontrar o equilíbrio
**Make a compelling case** — apresentar um caso convincente
**Leave a lasting impression** — deixar marca duradoura
**Judge a book by its cover** — julgar pela aparência
**What bothered you?** — O que o incomodou?
**She gives short shrift to grassroots speakers.** — Ela dá pouca atenção aos oradores de base.
**Did you finish The Podium and the People?** — Você terminou The Podium and the People?

items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.
words: I suppose that’s one way to put it. ↘↗ (reserva)
Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: It is a brisk, absorbing study.

prompts.q: Voice a mild criticism with litotes.

prompts.model: Highly recommended for anyone who loves rhetoric.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence review of a book or talk on public speaking, with praise, a reservation and a verdict.
blocks.model: This brisk guide to public speaking is full of useful advice. The author lets real speeches speak for themselves. The book is not without flaws: it gives short shrift to online audiences. Still, these are quibbles about a lucid work. Anyone who dreads the lectern will find comfort here. Highly recommended.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
